page: OVHcloud r2-15 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by a KVM hypervisor on an x86_64 architecture. The server provides 2 dedicated physical cores and 2 virtual CPUs clocked at 2.2 GHz using legacy Intel Haswell-generation processors with disabled TSX. The processor configuration is paired with 32 KB of L1 data cache, 4 MB of L2 cache, and 16 MB of L3 cache. Cryptographic hardware acceleration is supported via AES, alongside AVX and BMI2 instruction sets, though modern vector extensions such as AVX-512 and AMX are absent.

Hardware allocation includes 15.0 GB of system memory, delivering a memory density of 7.5 GB per core. Local storage is provided through a bundled 50 GB SSD, while the configuration does not include a GPU or complimentary public IPv4 addresses, and lists a 0 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Memory benchmarks record large-block sequential read throughput of 22.28 GB/sec and write bandwidth of 15.09 GB/sec, placing memory operations within the bottom 10% to 25% of tested configurations.

Computational benchmarks reflect the older microarchitecture of the underlying host. The instance achieved a Geekbench multi-core score of 1783.0 and a single-core score of 1018.0, with PassMark CPU overall scoring 3050.61. In workload-specific tests, Redis SET operations reached 3.07 million operations per second, while static web serving throughput reached 2.73 GB/sec. Small 135M model LLM inference yielded 181.17 tokens per second for prompt processing and 60.67 tokens per second for text generation.

The r2-15 configuration provides a dedicated compute profile prioritizing RAM capacity over raw CPU execution speed. It is functional for memory-centric operational workloads that do not demand high multi-threaded compute, such as lightweight in-memory caching tiers, development databases, and mid-sized memory-resident worker processes.
description: OVHcloud r2-15 is a memory-optimized virtual server running on the KVM hypervisor with an x86_64 architecture. It is equipped with 2 dedicated Intel Haswell physical cores running at 2.2 GHz, 15.0 GB of RAM, and a bundled 50 GB SSD for local storage, with no GPU hardware included. The architecture provides 7.5 GB of RAM per vCPU, favoring memory allocation over computational throughput. Benchmark performance indicates lower-tier compute and memory bandwidth, scoring 1018.0 in Geekbench single-core and 1783.0 in Geekbench multi-core, with Redis throughput reaching 3.07 million operations per second. Hardware cost efficiency is driven by the density of dedicated memory relative to core count rather than raw compute speed. OVHcloud r2-15 is suited for memory-intensive services with modest CPU demands, including small in-memory key-value stores, staging databases, and RAM-bound background processing jobs.
